thread:
jamie-partners: Heads-up: Vendor request from AWS onboarding team. They want a single-page artifact that lists all activation steps and whos the owner for each part (legal, packaging, creds, images). Can someone assemble by EOD tomorrow?

sofia: I can help assemble. I'd like a thin runbook + demo creds pattern. Are we doing separate demo tenants per cloud or one cross-cloud tenant?

raj: Prefer separate per-cloud tenants to reduce blast radius and allow region-specific images. I'll start a spreadsheet with columns: cloud, region, image_id, publisher_account, sku_id, trial_flag, private_offer, demo_user, ops_owner, legal_notes.

natalie-legal: Legal items: localized EULA requirement for Azure EU regions, export control check for certain model weights, and data processing note. We need a contact for localization.

sam-eng: For images: AMI for us-east-1 is ami-0a1b2c3d, GCP image family is rfwd-core-v1, Azure image SKU is Redwood-Core-2026. Need to confirm kernel compatibility for older Nitro hosts. I'll flag incompatible hosts.

sofia: Runbook snippet (to be appended into doc):
```bash
# Create demo user (GCP example)
gcloud iam service-accounts create rfwd-demo --display-name="rfwd-demo"
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create demo-key.json --iam-account=rfwd-demo@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# Store demo-key.json in 1Password collection 'marketplace-demos' with TTL=5 days
```

security: Note: For demo users, disable long-lived console keys and set permission scope to minimal read-only for observability endpoints. All secrets must be stored in 1Password.

nate-runtime: I'll add a column for recommended instance types and suggested quantization profiles (8-bit recommended for hosted; int4 for dedicated GPUs where supported). Also note automatic prefix caching for chat workloads.

dani-marketing: Marketing needs: hero screenshot, 30s clip, and a 1-line product blurb. Can we get staging endpoints + short-lived tokens by next Tue?

jamie-partners: Yes let's aim for Tue for creative. For the single-page artifact: include an owners table, timeline, and minimal acceptance criteria per cloud (images validated, demo creds live, legal sign-off, offer draft in publisher portal).

marketplace-bot: Publisher portal offer created: offer-id: rfwd-core-2026. Publisher invite link: https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/pub/invite/ZZZ (expires in 72h).

raj: Uploaded initial sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/rfwd_onboarding_singlepage  I'll populate sample image ids and owners.

sofia: I'll provision sandboxes and post 1Password links when ready. Tagging @security for policy confirmation.

security: Confirmed policy: 1Password collection name 'marketplace-demos', TTL 7 days, rotate after use. No demo keys in shared drives.

natalie-legal: I'll reach out to intl-localization for EU EULA translations. Expect 48-72h if we need translated EULAs.

sam-eng: FYI kernel note: older Nitro versions require glibc 2.28 minimum. Documenting in sheet.

jamie-partners: Plan: EOD tomorrow for single-page draft, Thu AM partner review, Thu EOD publisher portal draft submitted. If blockers, flag here.

sofia: On it  will post 1P link when sandboxes live.

raj: Filling in the image fields now.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: Publisher invite expires in 72h.
